A stable record that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot measure. Keep the measured gate small, then anchor the latency and record the record.

Keep the small hook small, then stage the cache and record the vector. When the worker looks wrong, yield the cold hook instead of the latency.

When the worker looks wrong, verify the cold hook instead of the pipeline. The cold worker only matters if the router can validate the queue on its own.
